<!-- Generated by ModuleDocsGenerator from the annotations of org.hortonmachine.modules.NetcdfGridDumper: do not edit, change the annotations and regenerate. -->

Dumps the timesteps of a NetCDF grid to GeoTIFFs: projected grids of known crs keep it, the others are resampled to lat/long WGS84.

**Toolbox folder:** NetCDF<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** IO, NetCDF, HDF, MODIS, Raster, Time series, Reading<br>
**Authors:** Antonello Andrea<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.NetcdfGridDumper`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inPath` | file |  |  | The netcdf file or url to dump. |
| `pGridName` | String |  |  | The full name of the grid to dump, as listed by NetcdfInfo. |
| `pIncludePattern` | String |  |  | In case of no grid name, the first grid whose name contains this text is dumped. |
| `pExcludePattern` | String |  |  | In case of no grid name, grids whose name contains this text are skipped. |
| `pFromTimestep` | Integer |  | `0` | The index of the first timestep to dump. |
| `pToTimestep` | Integer |  |  | The index of the timestep at which to stop, excluded. If not set, only the start timestep is dumped. |
| `pFalseEastingCorrection` | Double |  |  | An optional correction on the false easting. |
| `pFalseNorthingCorrection` | Double |  |  | An optional correction on the false northing. |
| `pNorthPoleLongitudeCorrection` | Double |  |  | An optional correction of the north pole longitude of a rotated pole grid. |
| `pNorthPoleLatitudeCorrection` | Double |  |  | An optional correction of the north pole latitude of a rotated pole grid. |
| `doLatLon` | boolean |  | `false` | If true, projected grids are resampled to lat/long WGS84 also when their crs is known. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outFolder` | output folder |  | The output folder in which to store the dumped rasters. |
| `convertedFile` | File |  | The name of the converted file. |
